result.description: Ecwid by Lightspeed: cloud ecommerce platform that adds an online store to any website or social channel.
result.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 for public apps (code exchange at my.ecwid.com/api/oauth/token). Custom apps for a single store get secret and public access tokens directly, no OAuth. Calls use an Authorization: Bearer header.
result.access_detail: Sign up with Ecwid, create a custom app, and copy the tokens from the app's Details page. The pricing page shows no free plan and no API plan restriction. I could not confirm whether the API needs a paid store plan, so treat that as unverified. Listing in the App Market needs Ecwid review.
result.api_notes: REST API at docs.ecwid.com/api-reference. It covers products, orders, customers, categories, coupons, inventory and more. Every call takes a store_id path parameter. Rate limit is 600 requests per minute per token. There is no test mode, so use a separate test store.

evidence.quote: Ecwid uses OAuth 2.0 to provide secure access to the store data for public apps.
If you customize your own store, however, you can skip OAuth and easily get an access token for your store.
After signing up with Ecwid and getting a custom app, you already have two tokens:
Secret token grants full access to REST API (provided the app has all required permissions)
Read store products, orders, customers, categories and coupons; adjust inventory and update orders.
Ecwid by Lightspeed is a cloud online store builder which lets you instantly launch an online store on any website
Ecwid by Lightspeed is a cloud online store builder which lets you instantly launch an online store on any website
